description: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next UD-Q3_K_XL by Unsloth
gpu_tip: ~96GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus a 128GB DDR5 kit is the comfortable pairing — llama.cpp's MoE expert offloading does the heavy lifting here, so a bigger card buys less than it usually would.
mac_tip: Needs ~96GB — a 96GB MacBook Pro is right at the edge; a 128GB M4 Max or M5 Max is the safer configuration.
